answer: Copying the same citations across 282 aliases therefore pays the authoring cost 282 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the reef index resolves every citation against the delta checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the onyx audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 8 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
